definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own older brother when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧です。
examples.english: My older brother is a university student.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother lives in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧3⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦{年上|としうえ}→年上：07302_toshiue⟧です。
examples.english: My older brother is 3 years older.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}していて→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother is married and has two children.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたくて→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しています→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother wants to become a doctor, so he studies late every day.

notes:
{兄|あに} is the humble term for one's own older brother, used when speaking to people outside the family.

FAMILY TERM SYSTEM:
- {兄|あに}: my older brother (humble, to outsiders)
- ⟦お{兄|にい}さん→お兄さん：02858_oniisan⟧: older brother (polite, someone else's or direct address)
- ⟦お{兄|にい}ちゃん→お兄ちゃん：22785_oniichan⟧: big bro (casual, within family)
- ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧: big brother (masculine/informal)

USAGE:
Within the family, children often call their older brother ⟦お{兄|にい}ちゃん→お兄ちゃん：22785_oniichan⟧ or by name. {兄|あに} is specifically for describing your brother to others.

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧: my older sister (humble)
- ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧: my younger brother (humble)
- ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧: my younger sister (humble)

The pattern is consistent: plain forms for your own family, お〜さん for others' or polite address.
